PC CAD $1,500-2,500 plus two depth cameras, USB / power, mounts and shipping CAD $1,600-2,400 [U] budget allowance. Candidate: Orbbec Femto Bolt. Coverage / compatibility requires prototype.
[U] allowance; retains 15 x 8 ft wall panel. Image band is 15 x 4.5 ft. Sample-test UST performance.
Two landscape mounts and perimeter screen tensioning

Two video feeds, adapters, power and network cables
[U] allowance: video 200-400 plus power / control 250-600. Do not use a mirroring splitter.
Rear bay / shipping $700 + video software / raptor asset $800 + stock footstep / growl sound licences $100 [U] CAD allowances. Actual quotes / licence terms not obtained.

[U] CAD $900 budget: powered speaker pair $650, USB audio interface $100, brackets $100 and wired audio / power $50. Candidate JBL Control 2P pair + MTC-2P mounts. No subwoofer. Prices / availability not quoted.
[U] 25% contingency for a design still being tested. Edit percentage in A60.
Project Hours - Shared design, development and testing
13 h: projection / tracking design and procurement, including speaker placement, wired audio and sound-system sourcing.
13 h: fabric / tracking / video prototype plus speaker and USB audio-output check.

71 h: visitor tracking and forward / reverse video, projection mapping / blending and recovery. Audio plays separately: normal-direction footsteps during movement and growl cue on entry. Basic position-based stereo panning. Includes iteration.
30 h: projection / tracking integration plus speakers, brackets, USB audio, wired signal / power and level setup. Includes durable installation and iteration.
11 h: projection / tracking tests plus sound levels, audio cues, stop / reverse behaviour and restart recovery. Venue sound coverage requires test.
QA 4-8 h: tracking loss / re-entry, restart recovery and soak setup / review. Unattended soak time is not billed.
7 h: projection / tracking records and handover plus audio wiring, volume settings and sound-asset records.

21 h: one licensed-asset raptor clip, revisions / export, plus sourcing and editing stock footsteps / growl into separate playable audio cues. No bespoke creature modelling or original sound recording.

Main estimate. All labour hours are [U] planning estimates. Reliability and iteration are included within the delivery phases.
Overlap between the two 8 ft wide images: 1 ft [U]. Edit overlap in A59; combined width is calculated in D52.
Materials contingency: 25% [U]. Edit percentage in A60. Shared equipment and contingency are allocated to projector 1.
Nominal optical throw: 8 ft x 0.25 = 2 ft [U calculation]. Complete mounting / cooling / access envelope remains unverified.
Reserve 3-3.5 ft rear-bay depth provisionally [U]; verify model-specific mounting height and physical clearance before fabrication.
Use tensioned diffuse rear-projection fabric. Keep framing and exterior branding out of the beam paths and translucent screen back.
Assume familiar depth / playback tools, wired indoor installation. New technology adds x1.5-2 to affected work (not applied). Asset and camera compatibility unverified.
Excludes bespoke modelling / rigging, extra scenes, multi-person following, original sound recording / composition, subwoofer, main tunnel fabrication and ongoing attendance.
Visitor position controls video frame, pause and reverse. Audio cues play normally, independent of reverse video. Basic two-speaker panning; no surround system.
Prototype camera coverage, handoff and video scrubbing before committing. Calendar assumes 30 focused h/week, x1.3 approvals. Lead times and real hardware unverified.
